Rajadhi Raja Video Song from Mannan Tamil movie featuring Rajinikanth and Khushboo. Mannam Tamil movie also stars Vijayashanti, Visu, Goundamani, Manorama and Pandari Bai among others. Music by Ilayaraja,directed by P Vasu and produced by Prabhu.
Song : Rajadhi Raja
Singer : SPB, Swarnalatha
Music : Ilayaraja
Lyrics : Vaali
